tex_content.html:
For $\tau >0$ and $q\in M_\infty $, \[ |\nabla l_\infty (q,\tau )|\leq \frac3\tau d_{g_\infty (-\tau )}(q_\infty ,q) +\sqrt{\frac3\tau }C_1(\tau ). \]
Proof

\sketch Pass to the limit in Corollary 3, using weak lower semicontinuity.

□
